messages:
sophia: Pushed a new candidate embedding model to staging (pyro-embed). Running onboarding eval now — quick sanity: recall@10 on wiki-mini is down ~6% vs our current prod embed 😕
raj: saw the alert from eval-bot. Did you run with the int8 build or fp16?
maria: tagging the numbers I ran earlier — baseline (prod-embed v2) recall@1=0.42 recall@10=0.72, pyro-embed (fp16) recall@1=0.41 recall@10=0.70. int8 dropped more: recall@10=0.66.
sophia: I ran the int8 quantized transformer build to test perf. CPU/GPU perf looks good but quality drop is larger than expected. paste of the eval snippet:```
Model: pyro-embed int8
Dataset: wiki-mini (10k queries)
Recall@1: 0.395
Recall@5: 0.612
Recall@10: 0.663
NMI (kmeans 50): 0.48
Silhouette: 0.17
```
raj: thanks. two quick hypotheses: 1) per-channel quant mismatch from export step, 2) whitening/normalization order changed during preprocessing for this model.
maria: +1 on whitening. I noticed pyro-embed's vector L2 norm distribution shifted (mean 0.97 -> 0.82) after the export script. If we accidentally applied mean-centering before L2 norm it hurts cosine recall.
sophia: good catch. I pushed the exact export command to the staging commit: `python export.py --model pyro --quant int8 --perchannel --normalize post` — maybe should be `--normalize pre`?
raj: try rerun without per-channel first (fallback to symmetric per-tensor) to isolate. Also run a float16 run to see delta. Can you also run a quick k-NN evaluation with cosine and dot to confirm metric sensitivity?
sophia: kicking off two jobs now: (1) fp16, same preprocess (2) int8 but normalize pre-export + per-tensor. will post results. ETA ~12m.
eval-bot: job 1786004321-1 finished — fp16: Recall@10=0.702 (+0.039 vs int8), Recall@1=0.408. Cluster metrics stable.
sophia: fp16 basically matches baseline within noise — so quant is the main regressor.
maria: run a small ablation: quantize only the MLP weights vs quantize attention weights too. We saw attention quantization hurts more on short-context similarity tasks.
raj: also try a KNN index tune — reducing efSearch from 128->256 recovered ~0.01 recall in some cases (latency tradeoff). worth checking before killing the model.
sophia: noted. I'm going to: rerun int8 per-tensor, ablate attention-only quant, and index efSearch=256. I'll log full configs to thread. If quality recovers we can consider shipping quant profile that keeps some layers fp16.
maria: sounds good. if we still fail, we should run a short calibration on the quant ranges (max-abs vs percentile 99.9) — sometimes outliers skew int8 ranges.
sophia: agreed. I'll upload plots (norm hist, quant error heatmap) to the staging artifacts once ready. Thanks all :thumbsup:
devbot: reminder — please include the dataset holdout id in the job name for reproducibility (i.e., wiki-mini-holdout-2026-03-23).
